note: R5 attribution-only candidate design frozen BEFORE the R5 fresh validation set was received, opened, converted or run by any GitScore code. Hashes are of LF-canonical bytes.

fresh_set_state_at_freeze.statement: the separately instructed author was still running; nothing from it had been received

selection_rationale: D_S >= D >= C >= B >= A on every seen set; D_S additionally recovers genuine use that production loses when a setext heading ends a non-implementation section (R5 DEV dev-037), and recognises setext non-implementation sections.

D_S keeps 100% of genuine README use and true SUPPORTED on every seen set (R5 DEV 27/28 vs production 26/28; R4 DEV 31/31; R4 fresh 88/88; G22-R2 20/20, 19/19; VAL-1 36/36; VAL-2 23/23; G22-R README recall 14/14, 12/12), with 0 new false SUPPORTED and all corroborated probes kept.
Attribution-specific false SUPPORTED on the seen sets: 82 -> 17 pooled (R5 DEV 24->5, R4 DEV 9->0, R4 fresh 16->10, G22-R2 4->0 and 4->0, VAL-1 16->1, VAL-2 9->1).
All seen-set numbers are DESIGN results.

attribution_taxonomy.third_party_projects_and_documentation (: other projects, their docs / notes / translations, ports, clones, alternatives, inspiration, comparison, 'like X'
attribution_taxonomy.historical (B): use that is no longer current
attribution_taxonomy.future_or_hypothetical (C): plans, wishes, roadmap / todo items, 'can be generated'
attribution_taxonomy.markdown_quote_and_section (D): attributed blockquotes; links annotating external projects (inline or reference-style); linked list items under bindings / ports / community headings; (D_S) setext-aware section boundaries for production's 8D.3 heading denylist
attribution_taxonomy.out_of_scope: ordinary-English homonyms, explicit negation, mentions without use (B-type 'works with X')

exact_rules.implementation: scripts/evaluation_lib/m11g22r5_policies.py explain(text, start, end, 'D') + SetextContext replacing production's ReadmeContext inside the unchanged is_non_implementation_mention
exact_rules.scope: every README-safe alias (all 64); production 8D.3 still applies first; fall-through, one item per concept and MODERATE confidence unchanged
exact_rules.reused_verbatim_from_r4: _REF_BEFORE, _LIKE_BEFORE + use-verb override, _DOC_BEFORE, _DOC_THE_BEFORE + _DOC_AFTER, _OWNED_ELSEWHERE, _HIST_BEFORE, _FUT_WEAK, _FUT_AFTER, _TASK_OPEN, _attributed_blockquote, _LINKED_PAREN, _third_party_list_item, paragraph-aware sentence model, ATX+setext enclosing_heading
r5_changes_made_on_seen_data: _FUT_STRONG5: TODO / to-do marker requires a colon (R4 DEV dev-041 'A to-do list in one HTML file')
unchecked task item counts as future only under a planning heading (8c jango1324/Mentoria setup checklist under 'Database')

acceptance_gates_on_fresh_set_declared_b.G1_genuine_readme_use_retention: D_S keeps >= 95% of the genuine README use items (concept-level README items labelled 'use') that readme:v4 extracts
acceptance_gates_on_fresh_set_declared_b.G2_true_supported_retention: D_S keeps >= 95% of readme:v4's true SUPPORTED probes
acceptance_gates_on_fresh_set_declared_b.G3_no_new_false_supported: every D_S false SUPPORTED control is also false SUPPORTED under readme:v4
acceptance_gates_on_fresh_set_declared_b.G4_corroborated: every artifact-corroborated used probe stays SUPPORTED
acceptance_gates_on_fresh_set_declared_b.G5_no_non_attribution_change: (a) no non-README evidence item changes in any control; (b) every README item D_S ADDS is labelled 'use'. Documented exception: removal of README items labelled ordinary / negated / ambiguous is permitted and reported (removal of 'use' items is governed by G1)
acceptance_gates_on_fresh_set_declared_b.G6_g19_capability: G19 capability identical for all 39 concepts and all 64 README-safe aliases extracted from 'This project is built with <alias>.'
acceptance_gates_on_fresh_set_declared_b.G7_no_parser_regression: job parsing identical on every G22 corpus (G22-Q, G22, G21, G20, G17, G16, G15, M10/M10E) under D_S
acceptance_gates_on_fresh_set_declared_b.G8_attribution_false_supported_reduction: D_S attribution-specific false SUPPORTED (false SUPPORTED controls whose probe label is reference / historical / future) <= 50% of readme:v4's (at least 50% fewer)
acceptance_gates_on_fresh_set_declared_b.G8_target_justification: seen sets pooled 82 -> 17 (-79%) but those sets shaped the rules; the G22-R4 fresh set, whose rules were frozen before it ran, gives 16 -> 10 (-37.5%), the most honest out-of-sample estimate. 50% ('halve the attribution errors') is a meaningful target between the two, fixed before any fresh result exists.
acceptance_gates_on_fresh_set_declared_b.uncertain_handling: probes labelled uncertain are excluded from G2-G4 and G8 and reported separately; probes the job parser cannot resolve are 'unscoreable' and excluded from probe metrics
acceptance_gates_on_fresh_set_declared_b.also_reported_not_gated: overall false SUPPORTED; false README evidence (overall / attribution); occurrence-level genuine-use and invalid-occurrence rejection; provenance (moved snippet) changes; MatchStatus, numerator / denominator, undefined scores
acceptance_gates_on_fresh_set_declared_b.decision_rule: ALL gates must pass for a positive research finding; if any fails, STOP and preserve the failure; thresholds are not changed after the run; any revision needs a NEW fresh set

known_limitations: Ordinary-English homonyms are out of scope, so overall false SUPPORTED falls only modestly.
Lexical attribution frames are closed lists; unseen phrasings ('cheat sheet of common X', 'maintained by the community', an italic 'copied from upstream' note before a quote) stay false.
Fenced code is never attributed (copied upstream code stays evidence).
Level-aware section inheritance is not implemented: a '### X' subsection of '## Alternatives' escapes the denylist (inheriting would also discard '### Why we chose X').
A repository-name title heading that contains the alias ('# k8s-notes') is evidence under every policy.
Overlap blocking (8D.1 'React Native' then 'uses React') is not an attribution problem; O is a separate finding, not part of D_S.
The fresh set's author is an AI subagent of the same model family; not human-independent.
expected_rollout_scope: if ever implemented: readme_context.py only (one more is_non_implementation_mention signal + a setext-aware ReadmeContext + paragraph-aware sentence span), readme.py version bump readme:v4 -> v5; no registry, matcher, scoring, schema or API change
evaluation_methodology: real parser v15 / evidence pipeline / matcher v1 / scoring v2 via the G22-R2 harness; probe 'Experience with <display>.'; candidate applied by wrapping production's per-occurrence filter (plus the context swap for D_S); occurrence-level labels aligned by (repo, concept, order) after longest-alias overlap resolution; one held-out run
